content.short: Flood provides a user-friendly API and SDK for swift integration of trading features.
content.description: Flood is a DeFi Dapp and DEX aggregator. DEX aggregators are designed for end users, not developers, which can make their integration into apps or protocols challenging. Flood provides a user-friendly API and SDK for swift integration of trading features into apps, enabling users to execute swaps at optimal rates, with the process potentially completed in as little as 15 minutes.
content.meta: Flood is a DEX aggregator with a user-friendly API and SDK for easy trading feature integration. Discover Flood and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
